title: U.S. interest rates: 10-year lookup
summary: This Bank of Canada page is a data lookup interface for accessing historical U.S. interest rate series, not a research document or analysis. The page contains no actual rate values, commentary, or substantive content—it only provides a form for selecting date ranges and series types including Prime Rate, Federal Funds Rate, Commercial Paper rates, and U.S. Treasury constant maturity yields.

Series have associated CANSIM 'V' identifiers for reference
Data frequency options: Daily (business days), Weekly (as at Wednesday), Monthly (last Wednesday of month)
